scope: R4 and independent-checker/schema-negative portion of R7 only

implementation.independent_program: Python stdlib, strict expected scope/root/certificate input, no producer import or stored outcomes
implementation.tree_checks: Unique reachable acyclic single-parent nodes; full root domain; ordered disjoint exhaustive Cartesian partitions
implementation.leaf_checks: Integer exact GRID equality accepted; Fraction SHIFT on declared grid; independently reconstructed CRT by modular inverses; singleton NO_GRID exhausts all declared grid indices
implementation.partial: UNRESOLVED yields PARTIAL, never PASS; invalid input exits nonzero; host admission requires both complete summaries equal
implementation.execution: Exact already-hashed source bytes executed by python3 -I -S -B -c, shell false, environment allowlist, remaining absolute 10-second timeout, SIGKILL, 256 KiB output cap
implementation.retention: Strict root/scope/certificate/summary/source/output/evidence digest envelope; pure retained validator does not read files or spawn subprocesses
implementation.runtime_boundary: NODE_ENV development/test only; explicit nonlocal DEPLOYMENT_ENV denied
implementation.deadline: Observed monotonic deadline covers source read, generation, replay, parse, hashing, pure validation and final post-validation checkpoint

fresh_7776_scope.agreement: Python tree replay and separate flat TypeScript enumeration agree

negative_controls: Partition overlap, scope shrinkage, reordered partitions
Invalid GRID boundary, SHIFT grid alignment, CRT coprimality/order/residue witness
False singleton NO_GRID and incomplete UNRESOLVED
Expected root mismatch, digest mismatch, unknown fields, booleans, duplicate JSON keys
Source drift and unavailable/timeout/overflow injected process faults
Malformed independent output and production/staging dispatch
verification.typecheck: Fresh repository tsc --noEmit exit 0; concurrent builders may subsequently change other files
verification.targeted_lint: Fresh two owned TypeScript files exit 0

failure_history: Initial ESM namespace spies were nonconfigurable; test harness corrected to module-factory mocks
One follow-up test inherited mocked execFile; harness reset to actual implementations before each test
Initial tsc exposed required NODE_ENV child environment and a mock ChildProcess cast; fixed without widening runtime scope
Primary Builder separately corrected a BigInt literal in its owned file
limitations: PASS is complete finite-grid classification, not continuous-time LRC truth/refutation
No Allikvere all-prime regeneration, induction premise acceptance, formal or novelty certification
Producer currently emits GRID/NO_GRID leaves; SHIFT/CRT verification exists with independent positive and negative controls
Source/output hashes are local trusted collector evidence, not interpreter attestation or external signatures
Process deadline is hard for the child; synchronous TypeScript checks use observed checkpoints, not arbitrary JS hard preemption
No DB, worker, API, Git, deployment or historical record mutation by this Builder
deviations: Execute verified source bytes directly instead of reopening a checked path, avoiding a source-path TOCTOU
Keep Python output compact and store exact-output digest with a deterministic retained byte-consistency check
